translations.web: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.
translations.bsb: In this confident boasting of mine, I am not speaking as the Lord would, but as a fool.
translations.kjv: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
translations.asv: That which I speak, I speak not after the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of glorying.
